The plate is a square white plate, probably about 26 cm across. The food covers roughly 12 by 11 cm. It looks like chicken pieces in a creamy dressing with arugula and bacon bits, and the layer is fairly thin.

I estimate about 6 pieces of chicken at roughly 25 g each, so about 150 g of chicken. The creamy dressing adds roughly 30 g, and the greens and bacon add about 10 g. That gives a total of about 190 g.

For energy, cooked chicken breast is about 1.65 kcal/g, so 150 g gives roughly 250 kcal. The creamy mayo-style dressing adds about 120 kcal, and the bacon adds about 30 kcal. That comes to about 400 kcal, which I'll lower slightly to 380.
